ios.name: Momentum — Market Intelligence
ios.subtitle: AI signals and market insights
ios.description:
Momentum is an educational market-intelligence app for individual investors who want AI-assisted context before they make their own decisions. It surfaces daily headline analysis, watchlist alerts, and signal ideas with confidence bands and written rationales — then hands you off to the brokerage account you already use to execute.

What you get:
• Daily AI market summary written by Claude Sonnet 4.6
• Watchlist with price alerts and news deltas
• Signal ideas with confidence band and thesis text
• Portfolio view (link your existing broker via read-only)
• Charts and technicals for the symbols you follow
• Deep-link to Robinhood, Webull, Interactive Brokers, or Fidelity to trade

Important — please read:
• Momentum is not a broker-dealer and is not registered as an investment adviser.
• Momentum does not place orders on your behalf. Every trade is executed by you, in your own regulated brokerage account.
• Signals and analysis are impersonal educational content, published on a regular schedule for the entire subscriber base. They are not personalized investment advice.
• Investing involves risk of loss. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

Subscription options (auto-renewing):
• Free — daily summary, 3 signal ideas per day, delayed data.
• Pro ($9.99/month or $99/year) — real-time data, unlimited signals, watchlist alerts.
• Elite ($29.99/month or $249/year) — priority signal delivery, backtest credits, AI post-mortem on your closed trades.

Terms of Use: https://momentum-trading-bot-production.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://momentum-trading-bot-production.up.railway.app/privacy
